thread:
maya: Heads-up — I found a mismatch in the Quickstart 'Hello bootcamp' token matrix. The Node 'auth' example uses CLIENT_SECRET but the Python example shows API_KEY. CI fails when following the Python flow.

jorge: Ack. Can you paste the exact failing command / error? Also link the page you edited?

maya: Repro steps — clone, follow quickstart, run the example server. Error: 
```
HTTP 401 Unauthorized: missing client_secret.
Suggested envs: NODE: CLIENT_ID + CLIENT_SECRET, PY: API_KEY (but server expects client_secret)
```
Page: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/blob/main/quickstarts/hello-bootcamp.md#auth

sam: Oof. Looks like two different auth flows got merged. I think the server stub in the repo expects OAuth style creds but the Python snippet was switched to bearer token style during a refactor.

linh: I can do a quick PR to align the Python snippet to use CLIENT_SECRET + CLIENT_ID and show a short bearer fallback example. Do we want both flows documented or just standardize on API_KEY for the quickstart?

maya: For the bootcamp quickstart, keeping it simple is key — prefer API_KEY only. But the server stub should be updated to accept API_KEY too. Right now it's easier to change the snippet than the server.

jorge: Team preference vote: 1) change server to accept API_KEY (backwards compatible) + update Node/Py snippets to show API_KEY flow; 2) keep server OAuth-style and update Python to show CLIENT_SECRET. I vote for option 1 (API_KEY) — lower friction for new devs. :thumbsup:

sam: +1 for API_KEY.

linh: OK I'll author a PR that: 1) switches snippets to API_KEY usage, 2) adds a small note explaining other auth modes and links to the advanced auth page, 3) updates the server stub to accept either header. Will request review when ready.

maya: Thanks — please also update the token matrix table near the top of the page so it reflects 'API_KEY (recommended)'. That table confused the initial user.

linh: Will do. Drafted changes locally, pushing now. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3412.

docs-bot: New PR opened by linh: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3412 — checks: spellcheck, md-lint, linkcheck queued.

maya: Quick note for reviewers: pay attention to the Python snippet where we set the header — I switched from `Authorization: Bearer ${API_KEY}` to `x-redwood-api-key: ${API_KEY}` for the local stub because CI checks mask bearer tokens differently. We should be consistent but it's okay to use either — will add a short checkbox in the PR description.

jorge: Small nit: please keep the inline codeblocks <= 6 lines and avoid long example responses. We want the quickstart to stay compact for copy-paste.

linh: Good call, trimmed examples. Also added a tiny migration note in the top-of-page changelog section.

deploy-bot: CI for PR 3412 reported: md-lint passed, linkcheck failed on /advanced/auth.html#oauth (404).

sam: Linkcheck failure is probably due to the advanced auth doc being moved last week in a separate PR. I can restore the anchor or update the link. Which do we prefer?

jorge: Update the link to the new path, and add a follow-up ticket to reinstate the old anchor alias. We don't want quickstart blocked on a historical anchor.

linh: Fixed link in PR and pushed. New status: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3412/commits/2 — deploy-bot will re-run checks.

docs-bot: Linkcheck passed. All checks green.

maya: Awesome — requesting reviews from @sam and @jorge. If no objections by EOD I'll merge and cut a tiny patch release for the quickstart docs.

sam: Reviewing now. two small wording nits and one missing semicolon in the Node snippet; filing inline comments.

jorge: Reviewed, left a tiny suggestion about phrasing in the token matrix. Approve once addressed.

linh: Addressed comments, squashed commits. PR ready to merge.

docs-bot: PR 3412 merged by linh into main.

maya: Thanks all — I'll run a smoke check locally against the updated quickstart and confirm in this thread once I finish.

maya: Smoke check done — followed quickstart from a fresh VM, no auth errors. Marking this resolved. :white_check_mark:

jorge: Great ship! I'll add a short blurb to the next internal changelog about the auth matrix cleanup so support hears about it.

sam: Nice work.

linh: Thanks team.

deploy-bot: Docs site rebuilt and deployed: https://docs.redwood.ai/quickstarts/hello-bootcamp (cache may take 5 min).

maya: Confirmed live and link working. Closing thread. :party:
